hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "TOOLBOX-FIRST (standing director directive, non-negotiable). For ANY UNKNOWN / rejected parse / hang / reach gap / why-not-witnessed question, run PGEN debug tools FIRST (TOOLBOX.md) — do NOT eyeball the grammar, guess a root cause, or offer a strategy menu. The 3-step UNKNOWN protocol: PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DUMP_ALL (full list) -> PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DEBUG_PROBES ([plannable-probe] parsed/witnessed verdicts) -> scoped PGEN_TRACE_VERBOSITY=debug --trace-rules (names the predicate rejection). ANTI-SPIN TRIPWIRE: if you have analyzed for ~2 turns WITHOUT producing NEW tool output that pinpoints WHY+WHERE, STOP — run the toolbox, or build a tool, or escalate; never loop on analysis. A code change cannot commit without tool-backed WHY+WHERE + measured before->after verification in its task leaf (scripts/check_doctrines.sh enforces it via .githooks/pre-commit). See DOCTRINE_ENFORCEMENT.md."}}'

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ebnf) printf "%s\n" "PGEN EBNF GUARDRAIL — before changing any return annotation in a .ebnf grammar, RE-READ: the target *.ebnf grammar itself, grammars/return_annotation.ebnf (\$N | \$N::M[*] | single-star \$N* | flat-spread \$N**), docs/RETURN_ANNOTATIONS_REFERENCE.md, docs/reference/PGEN_ANNOTATION_NORMATIVE_SPEC.md, and memory feedback_quantified_group_extraction + feedback_ebnf_consult_annotation_docs. Copy the proven systemverilog.ebnf idiom; after regen ALWAYS verify with parseability_probe --parse-dump-ast-pretty before trusting the shape." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *rust/src/*|*grammars/*.ebnf|*generated/*) printf "%s\n" "PGEN TOOLBOX-FIRST GUARDRAIL — you are about to change CODE. This change cannot commit unless its owning docs/tasks/<TREE>.md leaf carries (1) tool-backed WHY+WHERE diagnosis AND (2) a measured before->after verification (enforced by scripts/check_diagnosis_evidence.sh via scripts/check_doctrines.sh in .githooks/pre-commit). If you have NOT yet pinpointed the root cause with the debug toolbox (TOOLBOX.md: DUMP_ALL -> DEBUG_PROBES -> scoped trace), STOP and do that FIRST. Do not guess; do not spin on analysis." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostCompact", "additionalContext": "POST-COMPACTION RESUME PROTOCOL — context was just summarized. Re-read: (1) README.md, SESSION_BOOTSTRAP.md, TOOLBOX.md, COMMIT.md; (2) live-docs — docs/book/src/roadmap-and-live-status.md (the live family-status view) + rust/test_data/grammar_quality/done_bar_family_register_v0.json (the claim), CHANGES.md, DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md, and the auto-memory MEMORY.md index (authoritative durable feedback — honor it); (3) live-books (MDBOOKs) — docs/book/ (top-level) and the per-parser book for the in-flight lane; (4) docs/TASK_TREE.md Active Task Trees + the owning docs/tasks/<TREE>.md for the current frontier. TOOLBOX-FIRST: diagnose any issue with the debug tools BEFORE acting (TOOLBOX.md). git log + working tree are the true state (committed per-leaf). Resume the in-flight lane where it stopped — do not restart it."}}'
